ruleset.name: bentley-skeleton-api
ruleset.description:
Controllers only. src/Api/Security, src/Api/Attribute and src/Api/Listener are excluded on the command line: voters, listeners and attributes live in the Api layer but are not endpoints, and holding a security voter to "three methods, complexity three" produces a worse voter, not a better one. They are covered by the general ruleset instead.
A controller is: a DTO in, one #[IsGranted], one service call, one response view out. That shape fits well inside these limits, and anything that does not fit is business logic that belongs in an Application service — where it can be unit-tested without an HTTP kernel. INV-07.
